processLesson.lesson: A schema that passes a smaller national tranche can still hide independent cardinality caps, and a declared provider rate is not enforced merely because requests are sequential.
processLesson.applied: Before acquisition, Round 66 tested the intended 80-taxon maximum across plan, national receipt, state reference, and Texas pair cardinalities; enforced one request per second on every attempt; and made stable-window drift restart-required rather than infinitely resumable.
processLesson.nextRoundChange: Every larger national tranche must pass an end-to-end maximum-cardinality semantic dry run and a timed rate-limit test before provider access.
